items.title: Coherent Rises 3% as Trump Presses Ahead With Chinese Optics Ban Despite Big Tech Lobbying
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent shares jumped 3% after Reuters reported that the Trump administration will press ahead with blocking imports of new Chinese optical transceivers. Replacing Chinese suppliers could reportedly take up to a decade, and Coherent, Lumentum and Applied Optoelectronics can compete for that demand.

items.title: Coherent Jumps 8%, Applied Optoelectronics Climbs 7% as U.S. Pushes Ahead With Curbs on Chinese Optical Gear; Lumentum Gains 4%
items.summary: Washington wants Chinese transceivers out of U.S. data centers, and optical stocks are surging on the news. But the plan hinges on a obscure material China could cut off, which could hurt the very companies it aims to help.
